science_question: In the EIGHT strictly source-coordinate-compatible original Terceira forest plots, does equally sampled spider community turnover contain additional out-of-plot predictive information about original woody plant turnover beyond physical geography?

provenance.v1_307_Event_receipt_required: NEW_EXPLORATORY_EIGHT_PHYSICAL_PLOTS_EQUAL_SPIDER_METHODS_RESPONSE_SEALED with committed cryptographic selected-original-Event and tree-site join hashes BEFORE first original species access

original_v1_300_beetle_prediction_refere.note: Different 10-plot vs 8-plot targets NOT directly statistically comparable; already outcome-exposed.

sampling.eligible_EVent_ids: Only v1.307 recorded 184 source-selected spider Events: 23 per each eligible original plot from 5 common original samplingProtocol categories, min counts over original ten author plot keys [2,3,3,4,11]. No source outcome-selected site/record substitution.
sampling.use_original_tree: Original Woody Event core for exactly same eight source plot keys; one tree Event per matched physical plot. No use of other unpaired tree plots.

taxa.trees: Original scientificName with source taxonRank species/subspecies, unique per source plot, never shoot count as independent observations
taxa.spiders: Original scientificName, source taxonRank exactly species/subspecies/morphospecies; unique species/morphospecies per original physical plot across 23 selected spider Events; no organismQuantity/abundance as primary
taxa.missing_or_ambiguous_names: If >5% of Spider occurrences belonging to selected original Events have empty or nonpermitted taxonRank/name, STOP, do not reinterpret them after inspecting outcomes

quality.if_any_failure: STOP_QUALIFICATION_NO_BETA_SCORE, do not widen to two spatially failed plots, select favorable taxa or replace sample methods

statistical_model.woody_response: 28 original unordered plot pairs, Jaccard dissimilarity 1-|A∩B|/|A∪B|; dependent pair observations
statistical_model.geographic_predictor: log(1+haversine_km) between original Tree Event coordinates
statistical_model.spider_predictor: Jaccard dissimilarity of spiders on exact same 28 plot pairs
statistical_model.base_reference: LOPO ridge intercept + training-fold standardized geography, fixed L2 slope lambda=0.1; train 21 pairs among seven other plots and test seven pairs of held plot, average across eight held-out original plots
statistical_model.candidate: Same base + standardized Spider Jaccard predictor, fixed L2 lambda=0.1
statistical_model.primary: Baseline mean heldout pair MSE minus Spider-augmented mean heldout pair MSE; higher is predictive improvement
statistical_model.null: 999 full plot-label permutations of spider community assignments among 8 author sites, fixed seed 20261028; never shuffle 28 dyad values independently, compute one-sided (1 + count(null_gain >= observed_gain))/1000
statistical_model.conditional_positive_label: Observed gain > 0 and > 95th percentile of plot-label permutation gains, else report non-support without an alternative model
statistical_model.comparator: Report qualitative sign only against earlier ten-plot beetle result; do NOT call same woody response plus 8 subset a new independent geography or an incremental ecological mechanism confirmation

critical_evidence_limit: Entire eight-plot cohort is selected AFTER response-opaque site-geography errors were observed; Woody responses have already been exposed under prior ten-plot beetle test, Spider remains unopened until this protocol and synthetic tests are frozen. This is a weaker exploratory follow-up, not independent confirmation. Fragment membership/autocorrelation and shared COBRA sampling context remain unmeasured.
